first.rationale: Earliest observed failure (R02): plan_length=0 with executed_actions=0 and status=goal_unsatisfied on every task — the plan is empty, so no action semantics were ever exercised. The likely earliest fault is the plan-producing entry point: the runner may call the planner under a different entry name/shape, or state parsing failed. I therefore add tolerant input normalization (_norm accepts lists/tuples/sets of JSON arrays), a fallback entry alias, and a final greedy/serial fallback so a non-empty legal plan is still produced even if BFS is never reached. Grounding logic is corrected/kept faithful to the declared domain: directed link used as given, pickup deletes (at s l), tighten consumes (useable s) and (loose n). Expected disappearance: plan_length > 0 and prompt_successes/total_successes increase from 0 on problem0/problem1.
